verses.english: By the star when it sets:
your companion has neither gone astray, nor amiss.
Nor does he speak out of [his own] desire:
it is just a revelation that is revealed [to him],
taught him by one of great powers,
possessed of sound judgement. He settled,
while he was on the highest horizon.
Then he drew nearer and nearer
until he was within two bows’ length or even nearer,
whereat He revealed to His servant whatever He revealed.
The heart did not deny what it saw.
Will you then dispute with him about what he saw?!
Certainly he saw it yet another time,
by the Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary,
near which is the Garden of the Abode,
when there covered the Lote Tree what covered it.
His gaze did not swerve, nor did it overstep the bounds.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.english: Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra

verses.english: Have you considered Lat and ‘Uzza?
and Manat, the third one?
Are you to have males and He females?
That, then, will be an unfair division!

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.english: These are but names, which you have coined—you and your fathers—for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjectures and the desires of the [lower] soul, while there has already come to them the guidance from their Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda
verses.transliteration_text: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda

verses.english: Shall man have whatever he yearns for?
Yet to Allah belong this world and the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.english: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession is of not any avail, except after Allah permits whomever He wishes and approves of!
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.english: Indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter give female names to the angels.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha
verses.transliteration_text: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.english: They do not have any knowledge of that. They follow nothing but conjectures, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan
verses.transliteration_text: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.english: So avoid those who turn away from Our remembrance and desire nothing but the life of the world.
verses.transliteration_html: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya
verses.transliteration_text: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.english: That is the ultimate reach of their knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided.
verses.transliteration_html: <u>Tha</u>lika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman <u>d</u>alla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtad<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.english: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, and reward those who do good with the best [of rewards].
verses.transliteration_html: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna
verses.transliteration_text: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.english: Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, apart from [minor and occasional] lapses. Indeed your Lord is expansive in [His] forgiveness. He knows you best since [the time] He produced you from the earth and since you were foetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not flaunt your piety: He knows best those who are Godwary.
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa

verses.english: Did you see him who turned away,
gave a little and held off?
Does he have the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.english: Has he not been informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses,
verses.transliteration_html: Am lam yunabba bim<u>a</u> fee <u>s</u>u<u>h</u>ufi moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa

verses.english: and of Abraham, who fulfilled [his summons]:
that no bearer shall bear another’s burden,

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.english: that nothing belongs to man except what he strives for,
verses.transliteration_html: Waan laysa lilins<u>a</u>ni ill<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> saAA<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa

verses.english: and that he will soon be shown his endeavour,
then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward;
that the terminus is toward your Lord,
that it is He who makes [men] laugh, and weep,
that it is He who brings death and gives life,
that it is He who created the mates, the male and the female,
from a drop of [seminal] fluid when emitted;
that with Him lies the second genesis,
that it is He who enriches and grants possessions,
that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius;
that it is He who destroyed the former ‘Ad,
and Thamud, sparing none [of them];

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.english: and the people of Noah before that; indeed they were more unjust and rebellious;
verses.transliteration_html: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha
verses.transliteration_text: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha

verses.english: and He overthrew the town that was overturned,
covering it with what covered it.
Then which of the bounties of your Lord will you dispute?
This is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old.
The Imminent [Hour] is near at hand.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.english: There is none who may unveil it besides Allah.
verses.transliteration_html: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun
verses.transliteration_text: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun

verses.english: Will you then wonder at this discourse,
and laugh and not weep,
while you remain heedless?!
So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship Him!
